title: Passive Voice Highlighter
description: Find likely passive-voice constructions in your writing with a regex highlighter — "was written", "has been taken" and more.
howto: Paste your text into the box.
Likely passive constructions (a form of "be" + past participle) are highlighted in yellow.
Click any highlight count to jump through matches; rewrite flagged spots in active voice.

faqs.a: It finds a form of "be" (am, is, are, was, were, be, being, been) followed by a past participle — a word ending in -ed/-en or a known irregular participle like "written" or "taken".
No. It is a fast heuristic, not a grammar engine: "was tired" is an adjective use, not passive. Use the highlights as prompts to review, not as verdicts.
Active voice is usually shorter and clearer: "The team shipped the update" beats "The update was shipped by the team". Some passive use is fine and intentional.
